test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

PREVENT
solution: The correct answer is '**Block**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Prevent**' is '**Block**'. • **Prevent**: to stop something happening or to stop somebody doing something. (किसी बात को होने न देना या किसी को कोई काम करने से रोक देना) • *Example: This accident could have been **prevented**.* • **Block**: to prevent movement through something. (रोकना) • *Example: As she left the court, an angry crowd tried to **block** her way.* **Correct Answer:__** *Block.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Push**: to use force to move somebody/something forward or away from you. (किसी को आगे की ओर या अपने से दूर धकेलना, ठेलना) • **Allow**: to give permission for somebody/something to do something or for something to happen. (कुछ करने की अनुमति देना, कुछ होने देना) • **Open**: not closed or covered. (खुला, अनढका या अनावृत) 3a:Tafc, The correct answer is '**Scant**'.
